'''Levandra''', born '''Catherine Beckett''', is a [[human]] [[quest giver]] and [[herbalism vendor]] located in a cave above [[Mossgrove Farm]] in [[Gilneas]]. Believed to be sick with the plague by her family, she was driven away from them and joined the [[Pellars of Wolfswood]].<ref>{{questlong|Alliance|43|The Hound and the Hunter}}</ref>
